verdict.rationale: Ollama exposes a REST API (and Python/JS libraries, OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoints) that covers core model management and inference, mirroring most CLI/GUI actions (ollama-gh-4, ollama-docs-9/10/11/12/13/20). However newer GUI-only features like the desktop 'Apps' tab for Claude/ChatGPT Desktop integration and local image generation are not shown to have API equivalents, and a community comment notes the GUI app lacks remote-instance connection that the API/CLI supports differently (ollama-docs-16, ollama-docs-22, ollama-comm-17). Missing for 10: explicit API endpoints for image generation and app-integration features, and independent confirmation of full UI/API parity.
